annotation.justification: The clause unambiguously states that when a sender includes a weight (the "q" parameter) in an Accept header, it should place that parameter after all other media‑range parameters. The wording does not allow two materially different implementation behaviours, nor does it omit a concrete constraint that would change the operational interpretation.
